verdicts.reason: Both cram the whole poster into a tiny leaderboard. The headline is stacked into three lines on the left, while the body copy and legal text are shrunk to an unreadable micro size, the legal text is about as large as the body copy, and the Solstice logo is too small to see. In A the body copy sits below the dark band, but in B it rides up into the dark strip, so dark text lands on a dark ground. That collision makes B slightly worse.
